title: F14 · breakup · Three Years
lines: n
Three years. Ended in six words.
n
She has not eaten since yesterday.
n
Everything in the room is his. The mug. The hoodie. The song.
n
At four in the morning she went up to the roof,
because she could not breathe downstairs.
n
Someone was sitting very still, with snow on his shoulders, in the middle of summer.
n
She knew that stillness. It was not peace. It was grief that had not moved yet.
n
They watched the sun come up.
And she noticed that he let it.
n
She went down, and ate one roti.
n
You do not get over it. You let the morning come. That is sadhana.
n
Kailasa. On Google Play.
